title: Seedream and Seedance get new engines
summary:
Seedream 4.5 and Seedance Pro-Fast lead a day of sturdier media requests, cleaner chat settings, and new community projects.

Seedream moved to 4.5, with a 2048-pixel default side length and support for up to 14 reference images. Seedance now uses Pro-Fast for both text-to-video and image-to-video. Smaller Seedream requests are scaled to the model’s minimum size, eligible failures fall back to 4.0, and reference images served with generic file types work across Seedream, Seedance, and Vertex AI Gemini.

Chat now sends thinking settings only to Claude and omits a default top_p value that could conflict with Bedrock requests. Video generation requests also use the image API base URL.

The community directories added Noir Ink Tattoo Studio for tattoo designs, Synapse for multi-model chat, and Aqua, a project for learning API development.

highlights.title: Seedream 4.5 images
highlights.text: Generate with `seedream` at a 2048-pixel default side length, or use up to 14 reference images for image-to-image work. [Browse Seedream](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=seedream).

highlights.title: Seedance Pro-Fast video
highlights.text: Use `seedance` for text-to-video or image-to-video generation with the Pro-Fast model. [Browse Seedance](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=seedance).
